transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you in today?
I guess I’ve just been feeling really wound up lately. Like my body is bracing for something most of the day, even if I’m just sitting at my computer or trying to relax after dinner.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about things like work, health, or other responsibilities, even when there isn’t an immediate problem?

Yes… I do. It kind of jumps around. I’ll worry about my sister in Arecibo, then whether I missed something at work, or my husband driving home, or bills, church things… just preparing for problems that haven’t really happened.
Do you notice any physical symptoms like headaches, stomach issues, or muscle tension when you're feeling this way?
Mostly tension, I guess. I feel wound up a lot of the day… like my body is bracing, even if I’m just sitting at my computer or trying to settle down after dinner.
Do you find it hard to control or stop the worrying once it starts?

Yes… I try to stop it. I’ll tell myself, “Daniela, enough, just focus on this report,” but then one thought turns into several more. Before I realize it, I’ve spent half an hour checking messages or going over what could go wrong.
Do you feel restless or find it difficult to relax, even when there's nothing pressing going on?
Yes… that’s pretty much why I came in. I feel wound up most of the day, like my body’s bracing for something, even if I’m just sitting at my computer or trying to relax after dinner.
Have you ever had sudden episodes where you felt intense fear or discomfort that came out of nowhere, maybe with symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or shortness of breath?
Not really… I don’t think I’ve had anything like that come out of nowhere. I get tense, but not those sudden episodes, no.
Do you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep because your mind is racing with worries, even when you’re tired?

Yes… mostly I can fall asleep, eventually. But I wake up around three or four, and then my mind starts up again—my sister’s appointment, something at work with the servers. Even if I’ve technically slept enough, I wake up feeling like I didn’t really rest.
Are your worries mostly about specific things that have happened or might happen, or do they feel more general, like you're anxious all the time without a clear reason?

It’s… more like it moves around. There are specific things, I guess—my sister in Arecibo, work stuff, whether I missed something, my husband driving home, bills, church commitments. But it doesn’t stay with one thing. My mind just keeps preparing for something to go wrong, even when nothing has happened.
Have you been feeling this way—worrying and feeling tense—more days than not, and has this been going on for several months now?
Yes… more days than not, I’d say. It’s been about thirteen months, since my sister in Arecibo started needing a lot more help from the family.
